name: Continia Software AppSource ruleset
description: These rules must be respected by the AL code written in the company

rules.justification: InternalsVisibleTo should not be used as a security feature.
The app.json file must specify an Azure Application Insights resource.
Validating that obsolete tags are specified is important
Validating that obsolete reasons are specified is important
Validating that obsolete tags are formated properly is important
Objects that can be referenced and which have been published must not be deleted.
Permission Sets should not be defined in XML files.
Table definitions must have a matching permission set.
Permission set extensions should not include wildcard permissions.
InternalsVisibleTo should not specifying a different publisher name than the one of this extension.
